title: Grab Holdings Limited (GRAB) vs. Sea Limited (SE): Grab Raises Its Outlook as AI and Affordability Pay Off

content_html:
Fatima Gulzar

Wed, August 12, 2026 at 9:50 AM EDT 4 min read

On August 4, 2026, Grab Holdings Limited (NASDAQ:GRAB) raised its full-year revenue and profit forecasts. The company credited AI investments and an aggressive affordability push for helping it grow even as fuel prices rise across Southeast Asia. The stock jumped as much as 4.9% in extended trading. On the other hand, Sea Limited (NYSE:SE) hasn't reported its own second-quarter results yet.

Why Cheaper Prices and AI Are Working Together

Grab has leaned hard into affordability this year. The firm is offering a budget "Saver" tier and spending heavily on incentives to keep both riders and drivers on the platform despite higher fuel costs. At the same time, the company says AI has made its operations meaningfully cheaper to run. CFO Peter Oey said AI has helped Grab ship products more than 30% faster and cut out nearly 40,000 hours of sales inefficiencies.

This makes you wonder: is Grab's combination of low prices and AI-driven efficiency a genuinely durable edge in a brutally competitive market? Or is it mostly a short-term response to a fuel-price shock that could fade once oil prices ease?

Grab's Bull Case

Revenue rose 22% to $997 million, beating the $990.8 million analysts expected, and net income jumped to $252 million from just $35 million a year earlier. Gross merchandise value rose 21% to $6.5 billion, and rides grew 28% year over year. Grab Holdings Limited (NASDAQ:GRAB) raised its full-year revenue guidance to $4.10 billion to $4.15 billion and its EBITDA guidance to $720 million to $740 million. The company also announced a new $750 million buyback. Oey said AI is "now embedded in the Grab way of life," pointing to faster product shipping and real cost savings that are already showing up in margins.

Grab's Bear Case

Grab spent $706 million on customer and partner incentives in just one quarter to keep prices low, a high, recurring cost of staying competitive. As of August 4, the stock is still down roughly 26% for the year and more than 50% since its 2021 debut, showing investors remain cautious even after this beat. Indonesia just cut the maximum commission. Grab Holdings Limited (NASDAQ:GRAB) can charge scooter riders up to 8% from roughly 20%, a real regulatory hit in one of its biggest markets. Competition keeps intensifying too, from GoTo Group, new entrants, and a possible Uber return to the region through its own Delivery Hero deal. Grab's planned acquisition of Foodpanda's Taiwan business is also still waiting on regulatory approval, now pushed back to October.

content_html_zh:
法蒂玛·古尔扎尔

2026 年 8 月 12 日星期三，美国东部时间上午 9:50 阅读 4 分钟

2026 年 8 月 4 日，Grab Holdings Limited（纳斯达克股票代码：GRAB）上调了全年收入和利润预测。 该公司将人工智能投资和积极的可负担性推动归功于其在东南亚燃料价格上涨的情况下的增长。 该股在盘后交易中上涨了 4.9%。 另一方面，Sea Limited（纽约证券交易所股票代码：SE）尚未公布其第二季度业绩。

为什么更便宜的价格和人工智能相结合

今年，Grab 大力关注可负担性。 该公司提供预算“节省”级别，并在激励措施上投入巨资，以确保尽管燃油成本较高，但仍能让乘客和司机留在平台上。 与此同时，该公司表示人工智能大大降低了其运营成本。 首席财务官 Peter Oey 表示，人工智能帮助 Grab 的产品交付速度提高了 30% 以上，并消除了近 40,000 小时的销售低效率。

这不禁让你想知道：Grab 的低价与人工智能驱动的效率相结合，在残酷的市场竞争中是否真正具有持久的优势？ 或者这主要是对燃油价格冲击的短期反应，一旦油价回落，这种冲击可能会消退？

Grab 的公牛案例

收入增长 22% 至 9.97 亿美元，超出分析师预期的 9.908 亿美元，净利润从一年前的 3500 万美元跃升至 2.52 亿美元。 商品总价值同比增长 21%，达到 65 亿美元，游乐设施同比增长 28%。 Grab Holdings Limited（纳斯达克股票代码：GRAB）将全年收入指引上调至 41 亿至 41.5 亿美元，将 EBITDA 指引上调至 7.2 亿至 7.4 亿美元。 该公司还宣布进行新的 7.5 亿美元回购。 Oey 表示，人工智能“现在已融入 Grab 的生活方式中”，并指出更快的产品运输和真正的成本节约已经体现在利润中。

Grab 的熊箱

Grab 在短短一个季度内就花费了 7.06 亿美元用于激励客户和合作伙伴，以保持低价，这是保持竞争力的一项高昂的经常性成本。 截至 8 月 4 日，该股年内仍下跌约 26%，自 2021 年首次亮相以来已下跌超过 50%，这表明即使在这次下跌之后，投资者仍保持谨慎态度。 印度尼西亚刚刚削减了最高佣金。 Grab Holdings Limited（纳斯达克股票代码：GRAB）可以向滑板车骑手收取约 20% 的高达 8% 的费用，这在其最大的市场之一受到了真正的监管打击。 来自GoTo Group、新进入者以及Uber可能通过其自己的Delivery Hero交易重返该地区的竞争也在不断加剧。 Grab 计划收购 Foodpanda 台湾业务的计划也仍在等待监管部门的批准，目前已推迟至 10 月份。
